context.analysis:
## Overview
[The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. It enforces strict regional data residency and regulatory compliance via isolated GCP deployments.]

## Key Elements
- Patients and Licensed Clinicians
- Local Pharmacists and Compliance Auditors
- Platform Administrators
- EU Telehealth Platform (GCP europe-west3)
- US Telehealth Platform (GCP us-central1)
- National EU E-Prescription Gateways and US Pharmacy Systems
- WebRTC Video Infrastructure
- Regional GCP Artifact Registries and KMS

## Relationships
- Patients/Clinicians to Platforms via HTTPS and TLS 1.3
- Platforms to EU E-Prescription Gateways and US Pharmacy Systems via mTLS and regional APIs
- Platforms to WebRTC Video Infrastructure via regional endpoints supporting sub-300 kbit/s degraded modes
- Cross-region data access via token-exchange proxies using short-lived OAuth2 tokens based on patient consent

## Technology Stack
- Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for isolated regional infrastructure (`europe-west3`, `us-central1`)
- HL7 FHIR and national standards for US and EU interoperability
- Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) via GCP KMS for region-specific at-rest encryption
- OAuth2/OIDC with FIDO2 hardware tokens for zero-trust IAM and PAM
- Cryptographically signed AI model weights stored in GCP Artifact Registries for EU MDR traceability

## Rationale
[Region-isolated architectures and token-exchange proxies ensure compliance with GDPR and HIPAA without data leakage. Localized synthetic monitoring and degraded-mode WebRTC fallbacks guarantee high availability for unstable rural connections.]

containers.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients across the EU and US. It enforces strict regional data residency, regulatory compliance, and high availability over unstable connections.

## Key Elements
- Patients, Licensed Clinicians, Local Pharmacists, Compliance Auditors, Platform Administrators
- React / React Native Web Application & Mobile Client Gateway
- Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) running Node.js/Go API Gateway and Python/FastAPI AI Symptom Checker Service
- WebRTC Video Session Orchestrator with STUN/TURN edge servers
- Google Cloud SQL PostgreSQL and Google Cloud Storage (WORM with Object Lock)
- Istio Service Mesh with Envoy proxy
- National EU E-Prescription Gateways and US Pharmacy Systems

## Relationships
- Clients connect to Web Application via HTTPS / JSON over REST and WebSockets
- API Gateway communicates with core services via gRPC over mTLS (Istio)
- AI Symptom Checker invokes Vertex AI and writes immutable audit logs to Cloud Storage via WORM
- Interoperability adapters securely transmit e-prescriptions to National EU Gateways and US Pharmacy Systems

## Technology Stack
- GCP (`europe-west3`, `us-central1`): Ensures regional data residency compliance
- GKE & Istio: Orchestrates container workloads and enforces mTLS service mesh security
- Python / FastAPI & Vertex AI: Powers the AI symptom checker with model monitoring
- Google Cloud SQL & Cloud Storage: Enforces regional encryption via CMEK and WORM audit logging
- Terraform: Manages Infrastructure-as-Code and compliance configuration parity

## Rationale
Multi-region container deployment on GCP naturally satisfies strict GDPR and HIPAA data residency boundaries. Edge-optimized WebRTC and circuit breakers guarantee resilient telehealth delivery even across unstable rural network connections.

Web Application & Mobile Client Gateway.analysis:
## Overview
Cross-border telehealth platform providing video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker across the EU and US. Enforces strict regional data residency and compliance via GCP multi-region deployment.

## Key Elements
- Patients, Licensed Clinicians, Local Pharmacists, Compliance Auditors, Platform Administrators
- Web Application & Mobile Client Gateway (React / React Native)
- Client Routing & Auth Interceptor (Envoy Proxy)
- Offline Resilience Cache (Redux Persist / SQLCipher)
- Session & WebSocket Multiplexer (Node.js / Socket.io)
- Consent Enforcement Interceptor (Node.js Middleware)
- API Gateway (Node.js / Go)
- AI Symptom Checker Service (Python / FastAPI, Vertex AI)
- WebRTC Video Session Orchestrator (WebRTC, STUN/TURN)
- Database and Storage (Google Cloud SQL PostgreSQL, Google Cloud Storage WORM)
- Service Mesh (Istio Service Mesh, Envoy proxy)

## Relationships
- Patients / Clinicians / Pharmacists / Auditors / Administrators -> Web Application & Mobile Client Gateway [HTTPS / JSON over REST and WebSockets]
- Client Routing & Auth Interceptor -> Consent Enforcement Interceptor [Internal HTTP/2]
- Consent Enforcement Interceptor -> API Gateway [gRPC over Istio service mesh mTLS]
- Session & WebSocket Multiplexer -> API Gateway [WebSockets]
- Web Application & Mobile Client Gateway -> API Gateway [HTTPS / JSON over REST and WebSockets]

## Technology Stack
- React / React Native: Cross-platform frontend supporting multilingual UI and accessibility.
- Envoy Proxy: Edge routing, TLS termination, WAF, rate limiting, and circuit breaking.
- SQLCipher: Client-side storage encryption for PHI protection on mobile devices.
- Node.js / Socket.io: Real-time event streaming and persistent connection multiplexing.
- Istio Service Mesh / Envoy: Mutual TLS (mTLS) zero-trust internal communication.
- Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Multi-region deployment in `europe-west3` and `us-central1` using GKE, Cloud SQL, and Cloud Load Balancing.

## Rationale
This architecture enforces GDPR and HIPAA data residency constraints by isolating EU and US traffic at the edge while utilizing zero-trust service mesh encryption internally. It guarantees high availability and rural accessibility through offline caching, circuit breaking, and resilient WebSocket multiplexing.

API Gateway.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for EU and US patients. The architecture uses a localized API Gateway to enforce regional data residency and compliance.

## Key Elements
- Patients, Licensed Clinicians, Local Pharmacists, Compliance Auditors, Platform Administrators
- Web Application & Mobile Client Gateway (React / React Native)
- API Gateway Internal Components: Routing & Regional Affinity Router, Authentication & Authorization Filter, Rate Limiting & Circuit Breaker, Interoperability Protocol Adapter (Go)
- Downstream Containers: AI Symptom Checker Service (Python / FastAPI, Vertex AI), WebRTC Video Session Orchestrator, Google Cloud SQL PostgreSQL, Google Cloud Storage WORM
- External Systems: National EU E-Prescription Gateways, US Pharmacy Systems, WebRTC Video Infrastructure

## Relationships
- Web Application & Mobile Client Gateway -> API Gateway: Client requests [HTTPS / JSON over REST and WebSockets]
- Routing & Regional Affinity Router -> Downstream Services: Internal communication [gRPC over mTLS via Istio Service Mesh]
- Interoperability Protocol Adapter -> External Gateways: E-prescription transmission [mTLS and regional APIs / HTTPS]

## Technology Stack
- Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Primary cloud provider utilizing `europe-west3` and `us-central1` for strict data residency.
- Go: Chosen for building the high-performance API Gateway components.
- Istio Service Mesh & Envoy: Provides internal service-to-service security via mTLS and traffic shaping.
- Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE): Hosts containerized microservices with horizontal pod autoscaling.
- Google Secret Manager: Manages external API keys and mutual TLS certificates securely at runtime.

## Rationale
The decentralized, regional API Gateway architecture ensures strict compliance with EU GDPR and US HIPAA by enforcing data residency per region. Istio-enforced mTLS, granular consent scopes, and robust protocol adapters guarantee secure interoperability and auditability across international healthcare boundaries.

AI Symptom Checker Service.analysis:
## Overview
A cross-border telehealth platform providing video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for EU and US patients. It enforces strict regional data residency, GDPR/HIPAA compliance, and EU MDR traceability.

## Key Elements
- Patients & Licensed Clinicians
- Web Application & Mobile Client Gateway (React / React Native)
- API Gateway (Node.js / Go)
- AI Symptom Checker Service (Python / FastAPI, Vertex AI): Comprising API Router, Pseudonymization & Sanitization, Inference Orchestrator, Audit & Traceability, and External Fallback Handler components.
- Database and Storage (Google Cloud SQL PostgreSQL, Google Cloud Storage WORM with Bucket Lock)
- Service Mesh (Istio Service Mesh, Envoy proxy)

## Relationships
- Web App / Mobile Client -> API Gateway: Manages requests [HTTPS / REST]
- API Gateway -> AI Symptom Checker Service: Invokes AI symptom analysis and logging [gRPC over mTLS (Istio)]
- Inference Orchestrator -> Vertex AI: Requests symptom analysis [HTTPS / Cloud APIs over VPC Service Controls]
- Audit & Traceability -> Google Cloud Storage WORM: Persists immutable logs [HTTPS / Cloud Storage API]

## Technology Stack
- GCP (`europe-west3`, `us-central1`): Ensures regional data residency compliance.
- Python / FastAPI & Vertex AI: Powers the traceable AI symptom checker.
- Google Cloud Storage WORM (Compliance Mode): Guarantees tamper-proof medical audit logs.
- Istio Service Mesh & Envoy: Enforces mTLS, traffic routing, and circuit breaking.

## Rationale
This architecture uses regional GCP deployments and VPC Service Controls to guarantee strict data residency between the EU and US. Containerized microservices, immutable WORM storage, and automated sanitization ensure compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and EU MDR traceability mandates.

WebRTC Video Session Orchestrator.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. The system ensures regional data residency and low-bandwidth resilience for rural users.

## Key Elements
- Web Application & Mobile Client Gateway (React / React Native)
- API Gateway (Node.js / Go)
- Signaling Controller (Node.js / WebSockets)
- Adaptive Bitrate Manager (Go)
- TURN/SFU Proxy Controller (C++ / Pion-based)
- Audit & Compliance Logger
- Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) with Cilium CNI
- Google Cloud External HTTP(S) Load Balancer

## Relationships
- Client Gateway -> API Gateway via HTTPS/WSS (TLS 1.3)
- API Gateway -> Signaling Controller via gRPC over mTLS (Istio)
- Signaling Controller -> Adaptive Bitrate Manager via internal channels
- TURN/SFU Proxy Controller -> External WebRTC Infrastructure via UDP/DTLS (SRTP media relay)
- Signaling Controller -> API Gateway via asynchronous gRPC for audit logging

## Technology Stack
- GCP (europe-west3, us-central1): Ensures regional data residency compliance (GDPR/HIPAA).
- WebRTC with DTLS-SRTP: Secures real-time video/audio media streams with blind-relay enforcement.
- Go and Node.js: Powers high-performance signaling and bitrate management components.
- GKE with Cilium CNI and eBPF: Optimizes UDP packet throughput and enforces network policies.

## Rationale
This architecture isolates media processing in regional clusters to satisfy strict healthcare data residency laws. The component design prioritizes audio and implements automated reconnection to maintain clinical continuity for users with unstable internet connections.

Database and Storage.analysis:
## Overview
A cross-border telehealth platform providing video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for EU and US patients. The architecture enforces strict regional data residency, GDPR/HIPAA compliance, and traceable AI outputs.

## Key Elements
- **People**: Patients, Licensed Clinicians, Local Pharmacists, Compliance Auditors, Platform Administrators
- **External Systems**: National EU E-Prescription Gateways, US Pharmacy Systems, WebRTC Video Infrastructure
- **Clients/Gateways**: Web Application & Mobile Client Gateway (React / React Native), API Gateway (Node.js / Go)
- **Services**: AI Symptom Checker Service (Python / FastAPI, Vertex AI), WebRTC Video Session Orchestrator (WebRTC, STUN/TURN)
- **Database and Storage**: Google Cloud SQL PostgreSQL (Enterprise Plus), Google Cloud Storage (Regional WORM)
- **Infrastructure/Mesh**: Istio Service Mesh, Envoy proxy

## Relationships
- **Web Application & Mobile Client Gateway -> API Gateway**: Sends client requests over HTTPS / REST and WSS.
- **API Gateway -> Database and Storage**: Persists patient data, operational records, and audit logs via PostgreSQL Wire Protocol over TLS 1.3 and gRPC over mTLS (Istio).
- **AI Symptom Checker Service -> Database and Storage**: Writes immutable audit logs to WORM storage and invokes Vertex AI via gRPC over mTLS (Istio) and Cloud APIs.
- **API Gateway -> National EU E-Prescription Gateways / US Pharmacy Systems**: Transmits prescriptions using HL7 FHIR (US) and national standards (EU).

## Technology Stack
- **Compute & Cloud**: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) deployed in `europe-west3` and `us-central1` for region-locked data residency.
- **Database**: Google Cloud SQL PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security (RLS) driven by consent metadata and short-lived IAM database tokens.
- **Storage**: Google Cloud Storage with WORM Bucket Lock and Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) via Cloud KMS.
- **Networking & Security**: Istio Service Mesh with Envoy sidecar proxies enforcing TLS 1.3.

## Rationale
Isolated GCP projects and regional database instances guarantee compliance with EU GDPR and US HIPAA by preventing cross-border data transfer without explicit consent. WORM storage and automated audit logging satisfy EU MDR traceability and accountability requirements.

Service Mesh.analysis:
## Overview
Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for EU and US patients. It ensures strict data residency, privacy, and traceability compliance via GCP.

## Key Elements
- Patients, Licensed Clinicians, Local Pharmacists, Compliance Auditors, Platform Administrators
- National EU E-Prescription Gateways, US Pharmacy Systems, WebRTC Video Infrastructure
- React / React Native (Web Application & Mobile Client Gateway)
- Node.js / Go (API Gateway)
- Python / FastAPI, Vertex AI (AI Symptom Checker Service)
- WebRTC, STUN/TURN (WebRTC Video Session Orchestrator)
- Google Cloud SQL PostgreSQL, Google Cloud Storage WORM (Database and Storage)
- Istio Service Mesh, Envoy proxy (Service Mesh)

## Relationships
- Patients and clinicians interact with the Web Application & Mobile Client Gateway via HTTPS/WSS.
- Client Gateway communicates with the API Gateway via REST/gRPC.
- API Gateway routes internal traffic through the Istio Service Mesh using mTLS (gRPC/HTTP2).
- Data Plane Proxy queries the Consent Management Service via gRPC using the ExtAuthz filter.
- Control Plane pushes routing and security policies to the Data Plane Proxy via gRPC.

## Technology Stack
- GCP (`europe-west3`, `us-central1`): Core cloud infrastructure ensuring regional isolation.
- Istio Service Mesh & Envoy proxy: Enforces strict mTLS and routing policies.
- React & React Native: Cross-platform client delivery for web and mobile.
- Python / FastAPI & Vertex AI: Powers traceable AI symptom recommendations.
- OpenTelemetry & Prometheus: Captures audit logs, metrics, and model versions.

## Rationale
This architecture guarantees strict regional isolation and regulatory compliance with GDPR and HIPAA mandates. The Istio service mesh enforces security and consent-driven access control without compromising availability in low-bandwidth environments.
